vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.infoHotwords: Custom hotwords: enter proper nouns, names, product names, etc. These are sent as hints to the ASR engine (Whisper) to improve recognition accuracy for your specific terms.
vocab.infoRules: Correction rules: only applied during AI polishing (post-processing), does NOT affect raw transcription output. Requires a configured AI provider in Services and using a post-processing hotkey during transcription to automatically replace misrecognized words with the correct spelling (e.g. "face-bookie" → "Facebook").
vocab.hotwordsDescription: Enter words you want the ASR engine to recognize accurately:
vocab.rulesDescription: Replace misrecognized words during AI polishing (does not affect raw transcription):

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.
